title: One Policy Is Enough: Single-Agent Reinforcement Learning Outperforms Tree Search for Chemistry Tool Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chemistry questions often demand exact computation and database lookups that a language model cannot supply from its parameters, so it must reach for external tools. Tool use here is a three-part problem: select the right tool from a large pool, fill it with correctly typed arguments, and chain calls so that each consumes the outputs of the last. CheMatAgent, a previously published system, addresses this with hierarchical evolutionary MCTS: separate policy and execution models searching tool-call trees under two learned critics, one regressed partly onto GPT-assigned scores. We show that a single policy suffices. Our model interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and returns in one left-to-right generation, trained by a supervised warm-up and then outcome-level reinforcement learning against a programmatic reward read directly off the gold call chain, which leaves no learned critic and no judge in the training loop. On ChemToolBench multiple

translated_title: 单一策略足矣：单智能体强化学习在化学工具学习中超越树搜索
translated_abstract: 化学问题通常需要精确计算和数据库查询，而语言模型无法仅凭其参数提供这些能力，因此必须借助外部工具。此处的工具使用是一个三部分问题：从庞大的工具池中选出正确的工具、填入类型正确的参数，并将调用串联起来，使每次调用都能使用上一次调用的输出。此前发表的 CheMatAgent 系统采用分层进化式蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）来解决这一问题：由相互独立的策略模型和执行模型在两个学习到的评论者（critic）指导下搜索工具调用树，其中一位评论者部分回归到 GPT 打出的分数上。我们证明单一策略即可胜任。我们的模型在一次自左向右的生成中交错进行推理、工具调用与返回结果的读取，先经过监督式热身训练，随后进行结果层面的强化学习，其奖励直接从标准调用链中以程序化方式读取，训练回路中既没有学习到的评论者，也没有裁判模型。在 ChemToolBench 的多个基准上（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文证明，在化学工具学习中，单一策略模型通过监督热身加结果级强化学习（奖励直接从标准调用链程序化读取）即可超越基于分层进化MCTS与双重评论者的CheMatAgent树搜索系统，且训练中无需学习评论者或裁判模型。
en_tdlr: A single policy model trained with supervised warm-up and outcome-level reinforcement learning, using a programmatic reward read directly from the gold call chain, outperforms hierarchical evolutionary MCTS-based tree search (CheMatAgent) for chemistry tool learning, eliminating the need for learned critics or judges in the training loop.
